field.label: Enable
field.help: Start the SMS gateway at boot and when the settings are applied.

field.label: USB device
field.help: USB ID of the modem as vendor:product, for example 12d1:15c1 for a Huawei ME906s.

field.label: USB serial number
field.help: Serial number of the modem. Leave empty to use any modem with the USB ID above.

field.label: Serial port
field.help: Number of the modem's serial port that answers AT commands. Port 2 is /dev/cuaU0.2 on a modem that is /dev/cuaU0.

field.label: Device
field.help: Device path of the serial port, for example /dev/cuaU0.2. When set, it is used instead of the USB device, serial number and port.

field.label: Baud rate
field.help: Baud rate of the serial port.

field.label: Heater phone number
field.help: Phone number of the heater, as the modem reports the sender of an SMS, for example +491701234567. Replies from this number answer the HTTP API; SMS from other numbers are forwarded by mail.

field.label: Heater code
field.help: Code put in front of every command sent to the heater. Leave empty to keep the stored code; with no code stored, 1234 is used.

field.label: Response timeout
field.help: Seconds the HTTP API waits for the heater's reply.

field.label: Listen address
field.help: IP address the HTTP API listens on. Leave empty to listen on all addresses. A firewall rule must pass the port to it.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: TCP port the HTTP API listens on.

field.label: API password
field.help: Password a send request must carry. Leave empty to keep the stored password.

field.label: SMTP host
field.help: Mail server that received SMS are sent through, on port 25. Leave empty to forward nothing.

field.label: SMTP username
field.help: Username for CRAM-MD5 authentication at the mail server.

field.label: SMTP password
field.help: Password for CRAM-MD5 authentication at the mail server. Leave empty to keep the stored password.

field.label: Forward address
field.help: Mail address that received SMS are sent to.

field.label: Sender address
field.help: Mail address the forwarded SMS are sent from.
